name: map-cinematic-follow
title: Google Satellite Cinematic Follow
description: Follow a short portion of a Directions route with a controlled satellite-map camera and gentle heading movement.
use: A short cinematic route interlude between two actual Vlog shots.
snippet:
## Cinematic-Follow
layout:parallel
- map view:cinematic mapType:satellite duration:4 cinematic:{mode:flyAlong,headingFollow:false,tilt:25} camera:{zoom:tween(13,14,easeInOut),heading:tween(0,12,easeInOut)} waypoints:[37.7749,-122.4194,"Start";37.7799,-122.4144,"Middle";37.7849,-122.4094,"Finish"]
notes: Use a short contiguous waypoint subset rather than forcing six stops through a four-second shot.
headingFollow:true can swing sharply at turns; the calmer template uses false.
Default is a moving 2D Google satellite map, not real drone or photorealistic 3D footage.
